paraphrase: Homage to the one rich in devotion, for whom, without meditation, without repetition of mantra, without any prescribed procedure, the manifestation of Śiva simply occurs.

original.text: na dhyāyato na japataḥ syād yasyāvidhipūrvakam / evam eva śivābhāsas taṃ namo bhaktiśālinam
